title: Let’s review what we learned
intro: Dhuhr, Asr and Isha, witr, mash, cleanliness, health and tayammum – let’s repeat.

learn.html: Let’s repeat what we have learned. Do the activities, then answer the questions with your muallim.

learn.text: Fill in the tables in your notebook

learn.html: For Dhuhr, Asr and Isha, write what we recite in each rak‘ah and sitting of the sunnah, the fard and the last sunnah. Also describe how we pray the third rak‘ah of witr.

items: What is mash? How do we wipe over khuffs, and over a bandage or a part of the body we can’t wash because of illness?
When is wiping over khuffs not valid?
Which impurities must we keep away from?
How do we look after our health? What especially harms it?

questions.q: How many fard rak‘ahs does Dhuhr have?
In the 3rd and 4th rak‘ah of a fard, what do we recite standing?
What do we recite in the 3rd rak‘ah of witr?
How long can a traveller wipe over khuffs?

practice.title: Which prayer?
practice.prompt: How many rak‘ahs does each have in total?

practice.title: In your notebook
prompts: 📋 Fill in the tables for Dhuhr, Asr and Isha.
🗣️ Explain to a friend how to make tayammum.
